usageNotes: Creates a named IP/CIDR alias scoped to a specific VM's firewall ruleset, making it reusable by name in that VM's firewall rules instead of repeating raw CIDRs. Requires VM.Config.Network on /vms/{vmid}. Alias names must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores (2–64 chars); names are VM-local and do not propagate to the cluster or datacenter alias pools.

examples.summary: Create an alias for a trusted management subnet on VM 201

tips: Alias names are VM-scoped — the same name can exist independently at the datacenter level or on another VM without conflict.
Returns null on success; verify creation with the corresponding GET list endpoint.
Use datacenter-level aliases (POST /cluster/firewall/aliases) for CIDRs shared across multiple VMs or nodes to avoid duplication.
